channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Editorial | The surge is ending. The damage remains. Now what?
item.description: Minnesotans should keep demanding truth and accountability about ICE’s Operation Metro Surge, even as immigration agents depart.

item.title: Duluth’s curling pair are a couple. A couple of friends.
item.description: The world is curious about newly minted silver medalists Korey Dropkin and Cory Thiesse, whose success is rooted in friendship.

item.title: WCCO’s Jonah Kaplan is moving to CBS News
item.description: The veteran journalist will remain based in Minneapolis.

item.title: Gophers women’s basketball extends winning streak to seven with 84-67 victory over Nebraska
item.description: All five Gophers starters scored in double figures to improve the team’s record to 19-6.

item.title: Case dismissals, hastened plea deals follow U.S. Attorney staffing exodus in Minnesota
item.description: Normally a rarity, dismissals in Minnesota’s federal court have emerged amid mass resignations within the U.S. Attorney’s Office.

item.title: Minnesota resistance movement says drawdown is ‘hard-fought community victory’
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan said the ICE surge will soon end, but protest leaders say there’s a need for continued vigilance.

item.title: Head of ICE says he disagrees that Good, Pretti were domestic terrorists at Senate hearing
item.description: Senators grilled Minnesota AG Keith Ellison and immigration officials in tense hearing as Operation Metro Surge winds down

item.title: Judge rules Whipple detainees must have access to attorneys, private calls
item.description: A federal judge appointed by President Donald Trump said the government “failed to plan for the constitutional rights of its civil detainees.”

item.title: Border czar Tom Homan: Minnesota ICE surge to end
item.description: Homan said the immigration enforcement operation will be phased out in the next week.

item.title: DOJ moves to drop charges against men arrested after ICE shooting in north Minneapolis
item.description: Federal officials for days claimed a snow shovel and broom attack led an agent to shoot one of the men in the leg.
